timeline.summary: Motisons Jewellers signed an MoU with related entity Moti Developers to develop and lease a jewellery showroom in Udaipur.
Motisons Jewellers shareholders approved a proposal to raise funds via eligible securities and expand authorised share capital with 99.9991% majority.
Motisons Jewellers reported forfeiture of 82.7 lakh unexercised warrants, reducing its ₹170 Cr preferential issue proceeds by ₹105.44 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹137.47 Cr (+15.8% YoY), net profit ₹8.3 Cr (-25.5% YoY).
Sanjay Chhabra, Promoter and Managing Director of Motisons Jewellers Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter group’s shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
